note: Re-judged 2026-11-20 by an independent agent after the row gained a {partial} annotation and its producer clause was corrected. RFC 4301 Section 6.2: "If no SA exists that would carry the outbound ICMP message in question, and if no SPD entry would allow carriage of this outbound ICMP error message, then an IPsec implementation MUST map the message to the SA that would carry the return traffic associated with the packet that triggered the ICMP error message." Tested: "MUST map the message to the SA that would carry the return traffic"; Gap: "If no SA exists that would carry the outbound ICMP message in question", split by case: the ICMPv6 error. Producer: internal/component/ike/dataplane/xfrm_linux.go::xfrmPolicyFromParams, the first path::Symbol in the reason and the right one: it sets XFRM_POLICY_ICMP on the outbound protect policy from SPParams.ICMPErrorReturn (set by engine/child.go childPairPolicy), the flag xfrm_lookup_with_ifid requires before an XFRM_LOOKUP_ICMP lookup on the reversed header (icmp_route_lookup, xfrm_out_fwd_icmp) may use the policy; the earlier producer, xfrmStateFromParams, set the inbound reverse-check flag of 6.2-4 and was wrong. The tested scope is enforced. TestRFC4301ForwardedICMPErrorsMapUnderDiscard: under `unmatched discard` with no operator entry, a forwarded Destination Unreachable that no SA carries (the Child's policies are UDP only) meets the OUT catch-all (XfrmOutPolBlock +1) and is decrypted at the outside peer from the Child SA's own SPI byte for byte, beside a UDP control through that SA, with no copy in clear; its negative, the same error quoting traffic no SA carries, is seen neither protected nor in clear ("If no such SA exists, no SA will be created"). TestRFC4301LocalGeneratedICMPUsesReturnSA covers an error Ze generates for an authenticated closed-port trigger (NoPorts +1), decrypted from the return SA; the decoder also asserts the installed return policy's ICMPErrorReturn flag, and its untagged sibling without the flag is the control. The condition is held by commit refusals (refuseICMPErrorBypass: TestICMPOverlapBypassCatchAll, TestICMPOverlapBypassEntryRefused, TestICMPOverlapBypassTransitGate) with accepted disjoint and unchecked controls (TestICMPOverlapBypassEntryAccepted), covering protocols 1 and 58. The gap is honest: Section 6 says "The discussion in this section applies to ICMPv6 as well as to ICMPv4", every packet case is ICMPv4, and AC-8 of plan/release/validation/spec-ipsec-fragment-receive-and-kernel-proof.md owns the ICMPv6 case. Record finding: the new packet-test records break their producers (appendChildOutboundForwardPolicy, spdCatchAllEntries, xfrmPolicyFromParams) by a panic, which proves reachability only; the overlap-gate records are real mutants.
